name: Nexus Shopping
description: Shop across AI-enabled stores. Browse products, compare prices, complete checkout with your card on file or via secure link — all inside ChatGPT.

auth._comment: Anonymous-by-default: shoppers can browse, search, and use signed-link checkout (Flow B) without any account. Per-merchant in-chat checkout (IN_APP) future feature will request a JWT only when invoked, not at install time.
